headword: {訪問|ほうもん}{診療|しんりょう}

definitions.explanation: Medical care in which a doctor visits a patient at home on a regular, planned schedule, typically for elderly or bedridden patients who cannot get to a clinic. Part of home healthcare.

examples.japanese: {訪問|ほうもん}{診療|しんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{二回|にかい}→二回：27625_nikai⟧、{訪問|ほうもん}{診療|しんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: My mother receives home medical visits twice a month.
